"I like all of them. Don't matter to me I’m greedy"

There is something hilariously dark about how honest this moment is. In Killers of the Flower Moon (2023), Leonardo DiCaprio plays a man whose only real moral compass is his own appetite and Robert De Niro knows exactly how to use that. This was their first major feature film together since This Boy’s Life (1993), and seeing them back on screen one playing the puppet master and the other playing the "greedy" fool is pure cinematic gold. It’s a masterclass in Scorsese’s ability to find humor in the middle of a tragedy, proving that sometimes the most dangerous people in a room are the ones who just can't say "no" to anything. 

Despite being a technical and acting masterpiece that earned 10 Academy Award nominations, Killers of the Flower Moon famously walked away with zero Oscars.
